finding.claim: Context lookup uses cache.hasOwnProperty(name) then does cache[name]=value, so a lookup for 'hasOwnProperty' overwrites the method on the cache object and the next lookup on the same Context throws TypeError.
finding.title: Context cache breaks when looking up hasOwnProperty

verifier.reason: The cache is a plain object at mustache.js:377, lookup calls cache.hasOwnProperty(name) at mustache.js:397, and the miss path unconditionally assigns cache[name]=value at mustache.js:467, so caching a non-function 'hasOwnProperty' value shadows the inherited method and the next lookup on that Context throws.
